description: iterate.minimizeApprovals is turned on and a non-human APPROVED review is eligible for minimization (viewerCanMinimize defaults to true, author policy 'all' matches Bot). classifyReviewSummaries routes its ID into the same minimizeIds list used for review summaries; since it is not a first-look summary body, it surfaces only as a bare ID in '## Review IDs to minimize queue' rather than as a rendered approval or summary section. The approval alone (via reviewSummaryIds) makes this tick fix_code.
